Capacity & SLO requirements (customer-provided targets):
- Workloads: real-time chat assistant (primary), route-optimization embedding queries (secondary), reranking for alerts (sporadic burst).
- Peak throughput target: 800 concurrent chat sessions in primary region (~peak 1.2k requests/s aggregate across short bursts).
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile <= 120ms for 256-token prompt end-to-end (including network); 50th percentile target ~60ms.
- Availability target: desired SLA 99.95% for dedicated pool (requesting latency SLO credit language).
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit reserved capacity if predictable unit economics beat cloud on-demand by 20%+.

Reserved GPU pool planning (customer constraints & asks):
- Regions of interest: primary NA-east (closest to HQ), secondary EU-west for EU rider experience, tertiary APAC region for islands/partner operators.
- Proposed committed plan (customer draft): 40 x A100-80GB equivalents split as NA:20, EU:12, APAC:8 with 20% reserved headroom for AZ failover and maintenance windows.
- Failover headroom request: ability to absorb single-region outage with automatic cross-region routing + quantized fallback model variants to preserve latency SLOs for critical flows.
- AZ distribution: insist on at least 2 AZs per region for placement to avoid single-AZ spectrum failure.
- Autoscale policy: baseline reserved footprint with burst-on-demand via Dedicated burst capacity; want clear cost model for bursts.

Model & routing preferences:
- Prefer Llama-2-Chat-like variants tuned for conversation and a smaller quantized variant for failover.
- Want policy-based routing: latency-first in NA, cost-first in EU for non-critical batch workflows.
- Request automated fallback to lower-cost quantized models when headroom exhausted; fallback must be transparent and logged.

Security & compliance notes:
- Requires SSO (SAML) + SCIM for admin provisioning.
- Audit logs retained 12 months (must be exportable to their SIEM).
- KMS integration mandatory; evaluating HSM-managed keys.
- Data residency: EU customer data must remain in EU region for EU riders.

- Clear definition of what counts as SLA-impacting downtime vs scheduled maintenance.
- Recovery time objective for regional failure (target: automatic failover < 3 min for routing; degraded model quality acceptable temporarily).
